meshes.name: Mesh Generation
meshes.qfep_connection: Mesh topology as structural order â€” vertices, edges, and faces encoding surface geometry. The mesh IS the F-model of a shape: minimum triangles to approximate maximum surface detail.

artifact_groups.rationale: Vertex manipulation: geometric transformations applied to mesh surfaces. Translation, rotation, scale operating on vertices — the foundation of procedural geometry.
Noise-deformed sphere: Perlin noise displacing vertices along normals. Mesh topology maintained while surface becomes organic — procedural deformation in action.
Advanced mesh operations: geometric transformations applied to complex topologies. Building on vertex manipulation with multi-mesh coordination.
Mesh synthesis: all transformation techniques combined — vertex displacement, topology manipulation, and procedural deformation composing complete procedural geometry.
